narrative.text: I’ll add a follow-up commit that limits processing to the first two distinct quote targets and gives the whole lookup path a three-second budget. I’ll retain ordered delivery, add the regression tests, and support translated link text and tilde quote fences.The follow-up commit is `be08fd5`. All four new tests fail on `c741dc9` and pass after the fix. The hung-lookup test delivers the unrelated message after about 3.0 seconds. Fresh install, build, and full-suite gates pass: 296 passed, 0 failed, 1 unchanged skip.
